intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Burlington for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Downtown Burlington Holiday Market and Tree Lighting) through December 22 (Christmas in the Park), with the Carousel Ride with Santa at Burlington City Park (December 1 to 11), the B-Town Express (December 12) and the Cedarock Christmas Celebration (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Burlington

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Burlington
  • Free events, including the Cedarock Christmas Celebration and Christmas in the Park
  • Meet Santa: Carousel Ride with Santa (December 1 to 11), photos with Santa at the Historic Depot (November 28) and Holly Hill Mall Santa events
  • Tree lightings and downtown nights: the Holiday Market and Tree Lighting (November 28) and All Aboard the B-Town Express (December 12)
  • Shows and history: A Christmas Carol (December 11 and 12) and Christmas by Candlelight at Glencoe Mill Village (December 10)
  • Season: November 28 to December 22

Planning a bigger day out? Burlington families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Greensboro, which covers the Greensboro Science Center, downtown lights and the Triad's biggest holiday shows.
